one_liner: Prototyped AI-powered retail experiences for Coca-Cola, including a hydration-aware vending concept that recommends drinks.
projectSummary: Developed AI-powered experiential prototypes for Coca-Cola, including an interactive vending machine concept that analyzed hydration signals and recommended products.

goals: Explore how AI could personalize retail and experiential touchpoints
Create functional prototypes from early creative concepts
Simulate AI-driven recommendations and adaptive UI states
Help leadership evaluate feasibility for future brand experiences
responsibilities: Built front-end prototypes for AI-driven interaction concepts
Collaborated with designers and art directors to refine experiential flows
Simulated hydration detection, product recommendations, and adaptive UI behavior
Iterated quickly on creative and technical ideas during the innovation sprint
Translated imaginative concepts into interactive, testable demos
skillsUsed: UI development for experimental product flows
outcomes: Delivered interactive prototypes demonstrating AI-enabled retail experiences
